title: Double-integral Poincaré inequality for C¹ functions on a convex set of diameter ≤ d
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, ℝⁿ := Euclid n with Lebesgue measure Lⁿ (volume), Q ⊆ ℝⁿ convex and measurable, d ≥ 0 with ‖x − y‖ ≤ d for all x, y ∈ Q, and v : ℝⁿ → ℝ of class C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1 v). Then ∫_{x∈Q} ∫_{y∈Q} |v(x) − v(y)| dy dx ≤ 2ⁿ · d · Lⁿ(Q) · ∫_Q ‖Dv‖. Here the integrals are Bochner integrals for Lⁿ restricted to Q, Lⁿ(Q) is read as a real number (ENNReal.toReal), and ‖Dv(z)‖ is the operator norm of fderiv ℝ v z.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Q : Set (Euclid n)) (v : Euclid n → ℝ) (d : ℝ), Convex ℝ Q → MeasurableSet Q → 0 ≤ d → (∀ x ∈ Q, ∀ y ∈ Q, ‖x - y‖ ≤ d) → ContDiff ℝ 1 v → ∫ x in Q, ∫ y in Q, |v x - v y| ≤ 2 ^ n * d * (volume Q).toReal * ∫ z in Q, ‖fderiv ℝ v z‖
